title: Finch partners with Every to connect startups' payroll and HR data
summary: Finch has partnered with Every, the AI-native back office for startups, so Finch customers can access employee census and payroll data for employers on Every.
body_markdown:
Finch has partnered with[Every](https://www.every.io/) , the AI-native back office for early-stage startups. Applications built on Finch can now connect to employers on Every and access their employee census and payroll data through the same unified API they use for 250+ other payroll, HRIS, and ben admin systems.


The result is a win-win for both employers and the third-party applications they use. Founders who run payroll on Every can now share employee and payroll data with the tools they choose, from ICHRA platforms to 401(k) recordkeepers, without exporting files or re-entering data by hand. The partnership also extends Finch's provider network into one of the fastest-growing back-office platforms for startups: founded in 2021, Every now serves more than 2,500 customers and was named to Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies list for 2025.


"Startups are adopting benefits and HR tools earlier than ever, and they expect those tools to work with their payroll from day one. Partnering with Every means the founders building on Every get that experience, and Finch’s customers can serve them without a custom integration," said Ansel Parikh, Finch co-founder and COO.


## What the Finch + Every partnership means


Every gives founders a complete back office in one platform: incorporation, banking, payroll, HR, benefits, bookkeeping, and taxes. The platform focuses on startups from day zero to about 100 employees, and it pairs its software with dedicated payroll, benefits, and compliance specialists.


Through this partnership, Finch customers can access[organization](https://www.tryfinch.com/product/organization) and[payroll](https://www.tryfinch.com/product/payroll) data for employers using Every, including company details, the employee directory, employment information, and individual pay statements with earnings, deductions, and contributions.


Employers connect their Every account through Finch Connect, and Finch standardizes the data into the single, unified format Finch customers already use across the rest of[Finch's provider network](https://www.tryfinch.com/integrations) .


That opens the door to use cases like:


- [Health benefits and ICHRA platforms](https://www.tryfinch.com/solutions/ichra) — Pull census and compensation data to enroll employees, monitor deductions, keep eligibility current as startups hire
- [401(k) and retirement providers](https://www.tryfinch.com/solutions/401k-retirement) — Onboard startup plan sponsors faster with census and pay data from their payroll system
- [HR technology](https://www.tryfinch.com/solutions/hr-technology) — Sync the employee roster to automate onboarding, offboarding, and app provisioning as teams grow, and create workflows that use HR data as event triggers
- [Financial wellness benefits](https://www.tryfinch.com/solutions/financial-wellness) **** — Help employees save for the future, create personalized financial guidance, and power earned wage access by tying financial benefits to payroll
- [Finance and ERP platforms](https://www.tryfinch.com/solutions/b2b-fintech) — Bring payroll data into the books to automate journal entries and forecast headcount costs


For founders, that means less time on admin. The tools they add as they grow can work with their payroll data from the start, without CSV exports or duplicate data entry.


"We built Every so founders can spend their time building, not managing back-office systems. Partnering with Finch lets our customers connect Every to the benefits and HR tools they choose, with no extra work on their end," said Rajeev Behera, co-founder and CEO at Every.
